candidate_bugs.description: Id-based TYPE clicks the AX/SoM bbox center, sends Meta+A and Backspace, then keyboard-types into the current focus. It inherits the union_bound center mismatch and can clear/type into the wrong element while env.step reports success=True.
candidate_bugs.fix_sketch: Store an injected locator attribute for each exposed element_id and route type through locator.fill() or locator.click()/locator.press() with explicit actionability failure. Avoid global clear keystrokes unless the target locator is confirmed focused.
candidate_bugs.blast_radius_estimate: needs probe; likely broad on search and form tasks

candidate_bugs.description: Id-based CLEAR clicks union_bound center and sends Meta+A/Backspace. The creator accepts role/pw fields, but sync dispatch ignores them, so the default path can destructively clear the wrong focused element.
candidate_bugs.fix_sketch: Use locator.clear() for id-based clear after bid injection; support role/pw branches consistently or reject unsupported locator forms explicitly.
candidate_bugs.blast_radius_estimate: needs probe; lower frequency but high severity

candidate_bugs.description: Id-based HOVER maps element_id to union_bound center and sends page.mouse.move. Menus, tooltips, and card hovers can silently fail when the AX node bbox center is not over the actionable hover region.
candidate_bugs.fix_sketch: Route id-based hover through an injected locator and locator.hover(timeout=...). Return explicit failure when the locator is hidden, detached, or covered.
candidate_bugs.blast_radius_estimate: needs probe; likely clustered around menus/dropdowns

candidate_bugs.description: UPLOAD dispatch uses element center click inside expect_file_chooser. Separately, create_upload_action() sets action_type to TYPE at line 708, making parsed id-based upload bypass the UPLOAD branch.
candidate_bugs.fix_sketch: Set create_upload_action() to ActionTypes.UPLOAD and use locator.click() inside expect_file_chooser for id-based upload targets.
candidate_bugs.blast_radius_estimate: needs probe; likely rare but currently structurally broken

candidate_bugs.description: SELECT_OPTION is locator-based, but execute_action drops the parsed select_option arguments and calls locator.select_option() with no args.
candidate_bugs.fix_sketch: Forward parsed_code[-1].arguments and parsed_code[-1].keywords into execute_playwright_select_option(). Add a controlled select-option regression test.
candidate_bugs.blast_radius_estimate: needs probe; likely limited to Playwright-code action path

candidate_bugs.description: After any action, new-tab handling only polls browser_ctx.pages length and brings the last page to front. There is no expect_popup/load wait around target=_blank clicks, matching the known POPUP_OR_TARGET_BLANK probe category.
candidate_bugs.fix_sketch: Wrap locator-based clicks that may open pages with expect_popup fallback and bring the popup to front after load; retain page-count fallback for legacy coordinate actions.
candidate_bugs.blast_radius_estimate: existing probe category: 12 episodes / 13% of probed failures

axtree_findings.question: Q1 role inclusion rules
axtree_findings.answer: AXTree parse includes any CDP AX node with a non-empty rendered node string, filtering only nameless generic/img/list/strong/paragraph/banner/navigation/Section/LabelText/Legend/listitem nodes and nameless listitem nodes with properties. It is not a strict role allowlist.

axtree_findings.question: Q1 ignored properties
axtree_findings.answer: Properties focusable, editable, readonly, level, settable, multiline, and invalid are suppressed from the text observation, which can hide actionability and form-state clues from the agent.

axtree_findings.question: Q2 element_id assignment
axtree_findings.answer: AXTree visible element_id is the CDP Accessibility nodeId; backendDOMNodeId is stored only as metadata. HTML observations use DOM cursor indices; SoM uses a fresh drawing counter. IDs are observation-local, not stable backend identities.

axtree_findings.question: Q3 union_bound source
axtree_findings.answer: Bounds come from DOM.resolveNode plus Runtime.callFunctionOn; elements return getBoundingClientRect().toJSON(), text nodes return a Range.getBoundingClientRect(). The center is then normalized by viewport size.

axtree_findings.question: Q4 stale-cache risk
axtree_findings.answer: Metadata is rebuilt after each action, so there is no persistent post-step cache, but dispatch uses previous-observation bounds. AJAX/lazy rendering/layout shifts between observation and action can stale the coordinate and still produce success=True.

axtree_findings.question: Q5 role='link' non-<a>
axtree_findings.answer: The AXTree path trusts CDP role/name and does not validate tag or href. SoM explicitly includes [role='link']. Non-anchor links can enter obs and be dispatched by bbox-center mouse actions rather than locator actionability.

axtree_findings.question: current_viewport_only pruning
axtree_findings.answer: Nodes outside the viewport or below the 0.6 overlap threshold are removed and children are spliced into the parent. This can alter apparent hierarchy and ID availability between small scroll/layout changes.
